top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form. The chain from the incretin effect and proglucagon processing to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and receptor pharmacology is mature, independently confirmed over about three decades, and validated by large randomized outcome trials in diabetes and obesity. The citation rewards the physiology that made incretin therapy possible, and the three-laureate allocation is defensible on discovery priority. No award would withhold a clearly mature, high-impact achievement.
